title: Boss Phase Core
description: A four-image arena sequence that tracks one boss encounter through phase escalation and spatial change.
creative_direction: Image 01 defines the arena architecture and boss presence. Images 02-04 preserve that same encounter while escalating mechanics and destruction.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-intro-phase first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-mechanic-reveal, 03-phase-two-collapse, 04-final-burn-frame. Queue may run 02-mechanic-reveal, 03-phase-two-collapse, 04-final-burn-frame concurrently after 01-reference-intro-phase is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
